0022600202.text: The Kings (1-7) host the Heat (3-6) in the Kings' 10th game of the season, with Sacramento 0-3 at home and on a one-game losing streak, while Miami is 2-3 on the road and also on a one-game losing streak. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), De'Andre Hunter (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and no Heat players are listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their two 2025-26 games, with the Kings' most recent meeting a 130-117 loss in Sacramento on January 20, 2026.
